description: The single place prompts live, by name and immutable version, with rendering, tests, activation per environment and rollback.
Fixed wording with named placeholders such as `{{ ticket }}`; only declared variables change per request.
Rendering fails when a template variable is missing or an unknown variable is passed, instead of sending a broken prompt.
A rendered prompt sent to a model with a check on a property of the reply (allowed label, valid JSON). A small eval that gates promotion.
Making a tested version active in an environment such as staging or production. New versions ship dark until promoted.
Reactivating the previously active version of an environment, without a code deploy.
Searching instructions and examples automatically against a metric on a dataset, as DSPy does. Needs versions, tests and metrics first.
